# Openapi Codegen Agent Context

- Validate: `aw td check libs/openapi-codegen/tech-design`.

## Capability Map

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project openapi-codegen`.

- Blockers: `aw health --project openapi-codegen blockers`.

- Test: `cargo test -p cclab-openapi-codegen`.
